chunks: Whoever dies between the two holy sanctuaries will not have a record unfurled for him.
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for someone who dies between the two holy sanctuaries?
ai.summary: This hadith states a special merit for one who dies between the two holy sanctuaries. It indicates an exceptional ease in the reckoning of such a person in the Hereafter and highlights the virtue associated with hajj and the sacred precincts.
